environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on EC2 behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with direct TCP passthrough on port 443. No application-layer inspection. PostgreSQL RDS instance in same VPC with db.t3.medium, no query-level firewall. Service runs as ECS task with awsvpc networking mode. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to NLB and NLB to service on 8080.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15.4, no pgaudit, no query restrictions
config.runtime: ECS Fargate, task role has no restrictions on DB queries
